If you are neutral in situations of injustice, you have chosen the side of the oppressor. If an elephant has its foot on the tail of a mouse and you say that you are neutral, the mouse will not appreciate your neutrality. 
- Desmond Tutu
#BlackLivesMatter

Politics is the #BlackLivesMatter movement, and the white supremacists who seek to discredit it. Every sign, every cry of anguish by the Black community, that’s political. You May think your silence is political, but it isn’t. It is complacency.

#BlackLivesMatter #protests2020 #GeorgeFloyd

I encourage everyone in the mental health advocacy community to fight stigma not just for ourselves, but the most vulnerable. Unfortunately, we are living in a country where Black lives are at risk both physically and emotionally. #BlackLivesMatter

Derek Chauvin’s charge has been updated to second-degree murder and all 4 officers will face chargers. Too late for George Floyd. Too late for so many others, but I hope justice will be severe and swift. #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd #BlackLivesMatter

We still need justice for Breonna Taylor, and for countless others past, present, and future. It’s up to white people to continue demanding this alongside the Black community and stand up and say #BlackLivesMatter.
Unsure how someone can simultaneously say #BlueLivesMatter and #AllLivesMatter...but hate #BlackLivesMatter. Shockingly, you're only excluding Black lives. Must be a coincidence...
Hate to break it to ya, you can’t grow personally when you’re dead. #BlackLivesMatter
